slots.note: Clear anchor (shank, two curved arms, stock); a second stock and the ring beside the shank. The other three came out as scales, a cross and a misjoined anchor. Category Engravings (the one allowed).

All four diving helmets rejected (porthole-like oval frames, fake lettering, a robot face). Backup lantern reads well; the screened metal is a little blotchy. Category Photographs (nearest of the ten for an object; the cap kept Engravings to one).
Clean hourglass with sand in both bulbs; the others had flames, a three-lobed glass or a rod through the glass. Category Geometric (nearest of the ten).
All four were grey photographs of rods and crosses, none a key. The padlock backup (prompt in run50-10.py) would have started after minute 85, so it was not run.
The model drew whole horse statues on plinths, as grey or colour photographs, malformed; never a chess piece. No time for the rook backup.

lessons: For objects the model drifts to photographs ('pitted iron', 'wood grain') and to frames ('porthole'); 'chess knight' means a horse statue to it.
